messages:
maria: Quick sync 99we're planning a small X + LinkedIn push for the launch next Tue 9am PT. Need final messaging variants, assets (30s clip + 16:9 hero), and inbound lead routing. Who can own HubSpot webhook? Link: https://docs.google.com/example
sam: I can own scheduling. Propose two variants: A = product benefits (short bullets), B = benchmark narrative (latency/cost). Which for org X vs company LinkedIn? Also suggest employee seed 1hr before org post.
kevin: Clip edit done, color + captions in progress. Will export ~30s mp4 and separate SRT by EOD. Uploading to Drive -> marketing/launch/assets.
tara: Agree on HubSpot webhook over Zapier. I'll build form + workflow: source=launch-social, utm_campaign=launch_apr. Who gets sales notif in #sales-inbound?
maria: Channel plan: org LinkedIn = Variant B (benchmark), X = Variant A (benefits). Employee seed = short teaser (A). Sam schedule: employee 8:00am PT, org/X 9:00am PT, LinkedIn 9:15am PT.
sam: Will schedule and add follow-up wave at +6h if engagement <300. If >500 likes, trigger wave 2 with case study CTA. I'll import CSV into scheduler.
kevin: Assets uploaded: /marketing/launch/assets/launch_clip_v3.mp4, hero_16x9_v2.png, hero_thumb.png. S3 path: s3://redwood-marketing/launch/launch_clip_v3.mp4
maria: Copy variants in sheet. I'll add A, Tara add HubSpot form action and hidden field mapping. Copy samples below, pick tone you like.

Variant A (X): "Inference that scales — launch today. Faster, cheaper, predictable. Watch the 30s demo. ▶"
Variant B (LinkedIn): "How we reduced per-query latency by 40% and costs by 30% for production LLM workloads — a short breakdown and demo."

tara: HubSpot workflow: form -> list 'launch_leads' -> assign to SDR queue -> tag 'social_launch_apr'. I'll notify #sales-inbound for leads score>50. Form fields: name, email, company, use-case, consent.
sam: Scheduler CSV (import):
platform,post_time_utc,variant,asset
X,2026-04-06T16:00:00Z,A,launch_clip_v3.mp4
LinkedIn,2026-04-06T16:15:00Z,B,hero_16x9_v2.png
Employee_X,2026-04-06T15:00:00Z,A,hero_thumb.png

social-bot: Draft posts created in scheduler (id: sch_89421). Preview links posted.
maria: Next steps: sam lock times, kevin finish captions, tara post webhook URL, I'll finalize copy. React when done. :rocket:
sam: Times locked and calendar invite sent.
kevin: Captions exported and uploaded.
tara: HubSpot form + workflow created, webhook sent to crm@redwood.com, workflow id hs_wf_2209. Monitoring first 50 leads.
maria: Great work. I'll coordinate engagement replies and 1:1 outreach for demo requests. :party-parrot:
